attributes.title: AAS27: A Legacy of Hope — 60 Years Advancing Suicide Prevention
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Suicidology marks its 60th annual conference April 11 to 15, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Dallas. Pre-conference trainings run April 11 and 12 and the main conference April 13 to 15. The Healing After Suicide Loss Summit takes place on the final day.

AAS says each four-hour pre-conference session carries 4 CE credits. The tracks include clinical suicidology, 988 and crisis services, first responders and community programs. AAS is an ASWB-approved CE provider for social workers, and in 2026 it offered ASWB credit through selected clinical courses at the conference. Credit details for psychologists and counselors at AAS27, the fees and the full program are not published yet. Poster abstracts are accepted until February 1, 2027.
